title: Unstraightening equivalence over a standard simplex
statement:
Use simplicial sets and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], right fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], the cone adjunction and projective model structure of [lem-coef-cone-presheaf-adjunction], and $Q^\bullet\to\Delta^\bullet$ of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching]. For an integer $n\geq0$, let $\mathcal P_{\Delta^n}^{cf}$ be the full simplicial category of projectively cofibrant and fibrant diagrams $\mathfrak C[\Delta^n]^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{sSet}$. Its mapping sets have $m$-simplices the enriched natural transformations $F\times\Delta^m\to G$. Let $\operatorname{RFib}(\Delta^n)$ have all right fibrations over $\Delta^n$ as objects, with mapping sets $\operatorname{Fun}_{/\Delta^n}(E,E')_m=\{E\times\Delta^m\to E'\text{ over }\Delta^n\}$. Then
$$U_{\Delta^n}:\mathcal P_{\Delta^n}^{cf}\longrightarrow\operatorname{RFib}(\Delta^n)$$
is a Dwyer--Kan equivalence: its maps on mapping simplicial sets are weak homotopy equivalences and its functor on path-component categories is an equivalence. The enrichment here is obtained by applying $U$ to $F\times K\to G$ and precomposing with the natural map $U(F)\times K\to U(F\times K)$ induced by $Q^\bullet\to\Delta^\bullet$. This assertion is restricted to standard simplices and makes no assertion about a slice model structure for a general base.
